posting.title: Data Analyst
posting.description:
About the role:
Nordic Retail Group operates a chain of grocery stores across Denmark. We are hiring a Data Analyst to support our commercial team with reporting and dashboards.

Responsibilities:
You will build and maintain SQL-based reports on sales and inventory data, create dashboards in Power BI for store managers, and support ad-hoc analysis requests from the commercial team.

Requirements:
3+ years of experience in a data or business analyst role is required. Strong SQL skills are required. Experience with Power BI or a similar BI tool is required. No programming or machine learning experience is required for this role.

Location and work mode:
Hybrid role based in our Copenhagen office, two days a week on-site.

What we offer:
A friendly commercial team and standard Danish employment benefits.
